title: CongressMemberRecordV1
description: A member of Congress's public record in BillBoard (UX-39d), from GET /congress-member-record: their latest roll-call vote on each bill in BillBoard, newest first, a page at a time, and the bills they sponsored. Facts only, as Congress records them: no score, no ranking, no judging words, and no BillBoard user's vote.

votes.description: The member's latest roll-call vote on each bill in BillBoard that has one, newest first (by votedAt, then bill guid), at most the request's limit. A member in both chambers' latest roll calls of a bill (who moved chambers) has one entry for each. Empty for a member with no recorded vote, or past the last page.

nextCursor.description: Present when more votes follow: send it as cursor to read the next page. Absent on the last page.

sponsoredBills.description: The bills in BillBoard the member sponsored (not cosponsored), from BillBoard's member stats: the 119th Congress and each later Congress counted apart (REL-46), newest Congress first, then by updatedAt, newest first. At most 250 (sponsoredBillCount is the whole number). Sent on the first page only (no cursor).

sponsoredBillCount.description: How many bills in BillBoard the member sponsored, sponsoredBills or more. Sent with sponsoredBills.

billGuid.description: The bill's plain guid, such as BILLS-119hr1234.

billType.description: From the guid, such as hr or s.

title.description: The bill's title as the bills manifest has it; absent when the bill has no manifest row yet.

chamber.description: The chamber whose roll call this is.

votedAt.description: The roll call's day (midnight UTC), or when the vote was synced when Congress gave no day.

actionText.description: What the roll call was on, as Congress words it (a passage, a cloture vote, a motion), at most 500 characters; absent when Congress gave none.

position.title: CongressMemberRecordPositionV1
position.description: The member's position as Congress records it.

billGuid.description: The bill's plain guid, such as BILLS-119hr1234.

billType.description: From the guid, such as hr or s.

title.description: The bill's title as the bills manifest has it; absent when the bill has no manifest row yet.

vetoed.description: Only as true, when the bill's veto stands, as the bills manifest has it; absent otherwise.

updatedAt.description: The bill's date in the bills manifest (its latest news); absent without a manifest row.
